callback_mode() -> handle_event_function.

-define(KEEP_STATE(ReplyWith),
    {keep_state, Data, [{reply, From, ReplyWith}]}
).

start() ->
    gen_statem:start({local, ?MODULE}, ?MODULE, [], []).

stop() ->
    gen_statem:stop(?MODULE).
terminate(_Reason, _State, _Data) ->
    void.
code_change(_Vsn, State, Data, _Extra) ->
    {ok, State, Data}.

%% Initial state and data
init([]) ->
    State = start, 
    Data = [],
    {ok, State, Data}.

handle_event(

    start,
    Data
) ->
    io:format("Matched on stream magic"),
    {keep_state, Data, [{reply, From, ok}]};

handle_event(
    {call, From},
    {<<"received_data">>, <<116:8,0:8,13:8,78:8,101:8,116:8,76:8,111:8,103:8,111:8,32:8,55:8,46:8,48:8,46:8,51:8>>},
    start,
    Data
) ->
    io:format("Matched on NetLogo version"),
    {keep_state, Data, [{reply, From, ok}]};


handle_event(
    {call, From},
    {<<"received_data">>, Payload},
    start,
    Data
) ->
    io:format("Moving to collecting data"),
    NewData = [Payload | Data],
    {next_state, collecting_data, NewData, [{reply, From, lists:reverse(NewData)}]};

%%

%%

handle_event(
    {call, From},
    {<<"received_data">>, Payload},
    collecting_data,
    Data
) ->
    NewData = [Payload | Data],
    {keep_state, NewData, [{ reply, From, lists:reverse(NewData) }]};

%%
%% Definitions from 'all_available' - #4b7cc0f5fd5c55d3
%%

handle_event(
    {call, From},
    <<"send_out_data">>,
    all_available,
    Data
) ->
    {next_state, collecting_data, Data, [{ reply, From, ok }]};

%%

handle_event(
    {call, From},
    <<"missing_data">>,

    {next_state, not_all_available, Data, [{ reply, From, ok }]};
handle_event(
    {call, From},
    <<"all_data_present">>,
    check_data,
    Data
) ->
    {next_state, all_available, Data, [{ reply, From, ok }]};

handle_event(
    {call, From},
    <<"keep_collecting">>,
    not_all_available,
    Data
) ->
    {next_state, collecting_data, Data, [{ reply, From, ok }]};

%%

%%

                        
%% Fall through
handle_event(
  {call, From},
  Action,
  CurrState,
  Data
) ->
    io:format("FALL : ~p ~p ~p~n",[Action, CurrState, Data]),
    ?KEEP_STATE(ignored);


%%% Absolute fall through
handle_event(EventType, Stiff, State, Data) ->
    io:format("TEST : ~p ~p ~p ~p~n",[EventType, Stiff, State, Data]),
